output.summary: Bearberry is a small evergreen groundcover shrub widely distributed across circumboreal regions of the subarctic Northern Hemisphere. It has shiny, thick leaves, clusters of white-to-pink flowers and bright red fruits that persist into early winter.
output.edibilityNote: Blackfeet people use the fruits and leaves as food; fruits may be eaten raw, made into jelly or cooked with meat, and young leaves brewed as tea.
